subject.title: fix(discord): idle-timeout stalled API success response bodies

question: Should the exported Discord API impose a 30-second idle timeout when callers omit `timeoutMs`, or should only explicitly bounded/internal calls receive the new behavior?
rationale: The patch fixes a real unbounded-read path but also changes the default behavior of a public plugin API, so compatibility intent cannot be inferred solely from implementation correctness.

options.title: Confirm bounded public default
options.body: Accept the 30-second default after adding real stalled-loopback proof and focused coverage for the omitted-`timeoutMs` path.

options.title: Preserve omitted-timeout semantics
options.body: Apply `chunkTimeoutMs` only when callers supply a timeout and update OpenClaw-owned call sites to pass explicit budgets, leaving external default behavior unchanged.

recommendation.title: Confirm bounded public default
recommendation.body: Accept the 30-second default after adding real stalled-loopback proof and focused coverage for the omitted-`timeoutMs` path.

likelyOwner.reason: No Discord-specific historical owner could be established, making the repository routing owner the best available escalation point.
